# Producthunt (1 endpoints)

| /launches | `topic`?, `query`? | 1 | List current Product Hunt launches |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /launches — 1cr

Returns the launches Product Hunt is currently featuring, roughly 50 of them, each with its post ID, product name (post.ext.title), tagline (post.content.text), product page URL, the maker's display name, post.published_at (when the post was created, which can be weeks before its launch day) and post.ext.updated_at. Order is the feed's own and is not the vote ranking. Votes, comments and makers' handles are not available on this endpoint, so those fields are null. Narrow the list with topic, a Product Hunt topic slug such as artificial-intelligence, and filter it with query.

**Parameters**

- `topic` *(optional)*: Product Hunt topic slug, as in producthunt.com/topics/<slug>, for example artificial-intelligence or developer-tools. A display name such as Developer Tools is converted to its slug. An unrecognised topic returns no launches, with a note in data._warnings, and costs nothing.
- `query` *(optional)*: Case-insensitive text filter applied to the product name and tagline of the current launches. It filters this feed; it does not search Product Hunt's archive.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/producthunt/launches" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
